description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Cacophodon with haste.
The Cacophodon token enters the battlefield, triggering Marauding Raptor, dealing 2 damage to the Cacophodon token and giving Marauding Raptor +2/+0 until end of turn.
The Cacophodon token triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
